item.title: 5 of the most unusual Christmas traditions that non-Americans won't understand
item.description: Every country has its own Christmas traditions, but from hiding a pickle ornament to drinking egg whites, the US has some seriously unusual ones.

item.title: I wanted to be perfect like my grandmother. Then she asked me a question that changed my approach to life.
item.description: When my grandmother got sick, she finally let go of perfection, and taught me the freedom that comes with accepting imperfection.

item.title: How narcissism actually works, according to a diagnosed narcissist
item.description: Jacob Skidmore, known as the Nameless Narcissist, discusses living with diagnosed NPD, what narcissism feels like, and taking responsibility for harm.

item.title: I moved to a small beach town in another country. My new home felt like paradise, but I struggled to belong.
item.description: Although moving to a small beach town in a different country had its perks, it was lonely. I struggled to fit in as neither a local nor a tourist.

item.title: Dating after your partner dies is hard. I feel guilty for wanting connection, but I also need it.
item.description: I've learned that dating as a widowed parent means accepting a need for connection and feeling guilty for wanting it at the same time.

item.title: Epstein files feature photos of some famous figures within the disgraced financier's orbit
item.description: Newly released documents related to the Jeffrey Epstein probe reveal some of the high-profile figures who rubbed elbows with the financier.

item.title: Google and Apple are warning some visa employees not to leave the US due to 'significant' return delays of up to a year
item.description: The US State Department said it was "prioritizing thoroughly vetting" each visa case, which could cause delays.

item.title: I thought the best holidays were going to be when my kids were little. I was wrong.
item.description: I pushed myself so hard to make the holidays special when my kids were little. Now they are adults, and they are so much better.

item.title: 5 things we learned from the latest Epstein files drop
item.description: The Justice Department released new documents related to the disgraced financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein on Friday.

item.title: The US is now reviewing the social media of certain visa applicants. Here's everything you need to know.
item.description: The State Department is now reviewing the social media of some visa applicants, causing delays in processing for some foreign workers.
